source_text: These cases highlight causal trade-offs: while religious communities argue continuity of tradition outweighs deferred consent, critics invoke first-principles of non-maleficence, noting irreversible alteration without immediate medical necessity, amid source biases in advocacy-driven research that often amplify risks or understate cultural contexts.
